# ThreatFade Web

> Official ThreatFade website, documentation, research hub, interactive demonstrations and enterprise evaluation interface.

ThreatFade Web is the Next.js companion to the ThreatFade detection engine. It presents product information, evidence-governed research, documentation, evaluation workflows and authenticated analyst interfaces. It is not the detection engine itself.

## Project boundaries

- Web repository: https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-threatfade-web
- Engine repository: https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-threatfade
- Canonical website: https://threatfade.com
- Web source license: MIT
- Engine source license: Apache-2.0, governed by the engine repository's LICENSE.

The engine repository is authoritative for detection behavior, API contracts, validation evidence, integrations and security controls. Do not infer engine capabilities from marketing copy or this index.

## Build and verification

Use Node.js 20.19 or later and npm. Run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. The repository's CI commands are listed in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the package scripts in [package.json](package.json).

## Evidence and limitations

The site distinguishes implemented, tested, adapter, planned and not-claimed states in its engine truth manifest. Synthetic regression results are not independent real-world validation. Automated CI is not certification or a substitute for independent security assessment.
